en.title: Minimum Vehicles Turned Back on a Two-Car Bridge
en.description:
Vehicles cross the bridge in their original queue order, with at most two vehicles on the bridge at once. When the front vehicle leaves, the third vehicle enters immediately, and so on. You may remove any vehicles; find the minimum number of removals so that the bridge is never overloaded. You cannot insert waiting time or reorder the vehicles.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and the solution; the supplements for bounds missing from the source and the example corrections are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n U, and the second line contains n vehicle weights. The original has no numeric bounds; this site adds 1≤n≤200000 and 1≤U,weight[i]≤10^9. A vehicle that is overweight on its own must also be removed.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 4; 0; 1. They have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Track the last vehicle of the kept sequence; if a new vehicle together with it overloads the bridge, remove the heavier of the two; a vehicle that is overweight on its own is removed directly.
